## About

织梦空间聚合 AI 文章、工作流 Skills、项目矩阵和超级小王 Agent。内容关注 AI 产品、Agent 工作流、企业级 Skill 平台、阅读与资讯系统、自动化和工程实践。

## AI Agent Guidance

- Prefer canonical URLs and Open Graph metadata for summaries.
- Use article cards from the public article API when summarizing recent writing.
- Do not treat admin-only routes as public content unless explicitly authenticated by the user.
